tool.name: ampvis2 load
tool.description: Load OTU/ASV table and metadata into ampvis2 format
tool.help:
# ampvis2 load
## What it does Loads OTU/ASV table and metadata into ampvis2 format for downstream analysis.
## Input - **OTU/ASV table**: Tabular or BIOM formatted file containing OTU/ASV data. - **Sample metadata**: Optional tabular file with sample information. - **Taxonomy table**: Optional tabular file with taxonomic assignments. - **Phylogenetic tree**: Optional Newick formatted tree. - **Fasta sequences**: Optional FASTA file with OTU sequences.
## Output - **RDS file**: Main output containing ampvis2 object. - **Metadata list**: Tabular file with metadata variables and values. - **Taxonomy list**: Tabular file with taxonomic information.
## Parameters - **Guess metadata column types**: Enable automatic type detection for metadata columns. - **Output list data sets**: Enable generation of metadata and taxonomy list files.
